description: This file contains the implementation of a Timer class (TimerImpl) that wraps Linux's timerfd system calls, providing timer scheduling, cancellation, and expiration reading functionalities. It is a template class allowing different time units, and it depends on other network-related components.

classes.name: TimerImpl
classes.description: A C++ template class implementing a timer using Linux's timerfd system calls, providing scheduling, canceling, and reading expiration counts.

methods.name: TimerImpl
methods.description: Constructor that creates a timerfd with CLOCK_MONOTONIC.

methods.name: fd
methods.description: Returns the file descriptor associated with the timer.

methods.name: schedule
methods.description: Schedules the timer for repeated execution with specified delay and period.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads the number of timer expirations since last read.

methods.name: duration_to_timespec
methods.description: Converts a duration to a timespec structure.

methods.name: set_time
methods.description: Sets or disarms the timer with specified itimerspec.
